US Marines share footage of drone training

The footage shows training with Skydio X2D reconnaissance drones and a separate exercise using heavy-lift drones for medical supplies.

DroneDJ ↗19 September 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 4Videos 2

Bringing drones into regular units

DroneDJ reports on US Marine Corps training with Skydio X2D drones. The footage reflects efforts to build drone skills in regular units rather than relying solely on specialist teams.

The small-drone operator role

The article discusses the sUAS Operator role, with trained personnel returning to share skills with their home units. It describes the X2D as a small reconnaissance drone equipped with visible-light and thermal imaging.

An example of medical logistics

A separate video from an August exercise shows a heavy-lift drone delivering medical supplies to a simulated casualty-care location. It illustrates a logistics and medical-support application for drones.

Image and video sources

The report references two DVIDS videos and credits images to the US Marine Corps. These depict training exercises as described by the source, not combat operations during an actual incident.
